name: Halloween 2018
summary: The first Halloween event with a tier pass: 100 tiers bought with Candies, plus a Halloween Box, a leaderboard and the Batwing offer. It was extended five days past its planned Nov 7 end.
how_items_were_obtained: Each tier cost 100 Candies and the last tier gave a godly (Battleaxe II); Skeleton Keys opened the 2018 Halloween Box (godly: Boneblade); leaderboard ranks gave the Unique Hallow knives; Batwing was a standalone 2,499 Robux offer.

name: Christmas 2017
summary: Toy crafting returned: wrapped toys were traded for Snowflake Tokens and Winter Keys, with a Christmas Box, challenges, a leaderboard and a Winter Item Pack.

name: Halloween 2015
summary: MM2's first ever event: a Halloween lobby and a Bingo Challenge of role-based tasks, with no boxes, pass or leaderboard.
how_items_were_obtained: Completing a row or column of the 3x3 Bingo grid (Innocent, Sheriff and Murderer tasks) gave a reward; finishing all nine tasks gave the godly Spider.

items.name: Spider
items.how: Reward for completing every Bingo Challenge in the Halloween 2015 event.
